name: sec-edgar-mcp-server
description: MCP server for SEC EDGAR filings — provides access to 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K filings and insider transactions via the free SEC EDGAR API.

tools.name: get_10k
tools.description: Fetch the latest 10-K (annual report) filing summary for a company from SEC EDGAR.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, NVDA, MSFT)

tools.name: get_10q
tools.description: Fetch the latest 10-Q (quarterly report) filing summary for a company from SEC EDGAR.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, NVDA, MSFT)

tools.name: get_8k
tools.description: Fetch the latest 8-K (current report / material event) filing summary for a company from SEC EDGAR.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, NVDA, MSFT)

tools.name: get_insider_transactions
tools.description: Fetch recent insider transactions (Form 3, 4, 5) for a company from SEC EDGAR.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, NVDA, MSFT)
